@Nadia Fennimore: Gideon ended up at **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first posted 300. A couple of minutes later he corrected it and asked everyone to ignore that number. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280 in the thread.
